notes: TorchChain (src/TorchChain.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 built on OpenZeppelin ERC20 v5.1.0 with nothing added. name() returns Torch Chain, symbol() returns TCH, decimals() returns 18. The constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 TCH (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which at launch is the factory. There is no owner, minter, burn, pause, blocklist, fee, reflection or upgrade path, so totalSupply can never change after construction and no privileged call can move or freeze a holder's balance. Every transfer moves exactly the requested amount, so the factory, the PoolManager and the launch's MerkleDistributor need no exemption. The runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. This launch deploys the token alone: there are no application contracts and no initialization calls. The pool pairs TCH with IMD at 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127 on Robinhood Chain; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, since the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the supply.
